## Creator rules (put an x in each box, like [x])

- [ ] I made this game myself, or I have permission for everything in it.
- [ ] There are no real names, photos, addresses, schools or other personal info in it.
- [ ] Nothing scary, violent or mean that wouldn't be OK at school.
- [ ] No chat, no ads, no links to other websites, and it doesn't ask players for any information.
- [ ] I only changed files inside my own game folder.
- [ ] I'm 13 or older, or a teacher is sending this in for me.

A robot will check your game in about a minute. If it finds something to fix, it tells you what. Then your teacher plays the game and reads the code before approving it.
